metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 2005 · Jane Doe: Vanishing Act
metas.description: When a lone passenger with vital software disappears from an airplane midair, a mom, who quit Central Security Agency years ago, is secretly called in as consultant to solve the mystery.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 2005 · Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
metas.description: The Declaration Of Independence is stolen while on display in a Los Angeles Bank. The NSA with the assistance of a puzzle slover Code Name Jane Doe becomes involved and solves the mystery.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.3 · 2005 · Jane Doe: Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: When a ruthless arms Kingpin stages an ingenious escape from prison, Jane Doe and Frank Darnell, NSA head, realize he's bent on a vengeance killing. Who the prospective victim is remains to be seen.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.4 · 2005 · Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
metas.description: When it comes to crime solving, nobody does it better than Jane Doe.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.2 · 2006 · Jane Doe: Yes, I Remember It Well
metas.description: A famous mentalist who possesses the names of secret foreign agents in the middle east is about to give up this information to kidnappers unless a hefty ransom is paid within 24 hours.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.3 · 2006 · Jane Doe: The Harder They Fall
metas.description: Jane must get to the truth when a breakfast cereal magnate takes a tragic spill from his private yacht and drowns.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.1 · 2007 · Jane Doe: Ties That Bind
metas.description: DNA evidence and camera footage places a corrupt CEO as the prime suspect in the murder of a company whistle-blower, but Jane Doe believes the real killer may be a twin sibling.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.3 · 2008 · Jane Doe: Eye of the Beholder
metas.description: Cathy and Frank partner with a beautiful insurance investigator in the recovery of stolen art. Frank is smitten with her, even though it becomes more apparent she may be the mastermind behind the theft.
